## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      7 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 16, 2026 - Sep 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _carabury_, Sep 2, 2026, 1/5: "Be very careful with the “trial” — there’s an important restriction they don’t make clear. I signed up for a trial through a friend’s referral link and booked a class. I needed to reschedule and tried to do so within the permitted cancellation window. However, the app gave me no option to reschedule and instead told me I needed to sign up for the paid membership. I eventually had to Google the issue to find out why. Apparently, during the trial, you only get one appointment at a given location, and if you cancel that appointment—even within the allowed cancellation period—you lose the ability to book another one during the trial. That is a pretty significant restriction for a “trial,” and I don’t remember seeing it clearly disclosed when I signed up or booked the class. If the purpose of the trial is to let people experience the service, preventing someone from rescheduling a class they canceled within the allowed timeframe is incredibly frustrating. I contacted customer service hoping they could simply restore the trial booking. The chatbot was essentially useless, and when I finally reached a person, I was told they couldn’t help me. I would strongly recommend making this policy much more transparent. Customers shouldn’t have to Google the rules after the fact to discover that a permitted cancellation effectively uses up their entire trial. I’m leaving this review so other people know before they sign up: read the fine print, because “trial” apparently doesn’t mean you can freely reschedule your first class."
            2. _Gehshwizi_, Aug 30, 2026, 1/5: "Tried to cancel reoccurring membership during free trial and cancelled my free trial without using a credit. Set up a new account to try free trial and was blocked by the app from using it. Then it billed me a recurring charge. Scam artists"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Mar 14, 2026 - Aug 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Katie-1812_, Aug 26, 2026, 1/5: "I made an appointment through class pass at the end of the month and the business was unable to fulfill the appointment. They knew this ahead of time but were unable to contact me to notify me of the cancellation due to class pass communications limitations. I didn’t have time to reschedule a new appointment before the end of the month and class pass refused to let my unused credits rollover to the next month. Buyer beware if you have any issues with an appointment, class pass will provide little support and you may lose all the credits you paid for."
            2. _mattallsop_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "I have reported the issue to my bank. This app should be reviewed by Apple for breach of app store rules on billing."
            3. ___Mari__, Jul 19, 2026, 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
